en: Cūḷantaraduka, Kusalattika (The Lesser Intermediate Dyads, Wholesome Triads)
Dependent on a state that is neither a condition nor wholesome … (one for all cases).
Dependent on a state that is neither unconditioned nor wholesome … (one for all cases).
Dependent on a state that is neither non-obscured nor wholesome … (abbreviated).
With respect to root-cause condition, three; with respect to object condition, one ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance condition, three.
Dependent on a state that is neither impinging nor wholesome ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither impinging nor wholesome ... (Abbreviated. With respect to root-cause condition, nine;
with respect to object condition, one ... pe ... with respect to mutuality condition, six ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance condition, nine.
Dependent on a non-material, non-wholesome state … dependent on a non-material, non-wholesome state … (Abbreviated.

Nine in the case of root; three in the case of object; five in the case of predominance … six in the case of mutuality … one in the case of prenascence and repetition … nine in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-worldly, non-wholesome state … dependent on a supramundane, non-wholesome state … (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition, five; in the case of object condition, two ... pe ... in the case of repetition condition, one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, five.

Dependent on a state that is neither cognizable by any [sense] nor unwholesome ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither cognizable by any [sense] nor unwholesome ... (Abbreviated. In the case of root condition, nine ... pe ...
in the case of non-disappearance condition, nine.
